p.s: An especiall invitation
It was dangerous, but I knew I had to do it.
I was having holidays with my parents and some friends in India and we were enjoying talking to people and eating the local food.
One day we were invited from locals to visit a little town five hours away from New Dehli.
Although my parents were very happy of having such an especial opportunity visiting a place with no tourists, I was a little bit scared.

In this country my parents used to buy water in bottles to have it clean, but in the little town we didn't had this possibility and the family where we were staying with, kindly boiled the water for us.
We spent 2 weeks with the family.
The first week was find, but on the second week I got very seek.
I think it was the water.
My mother tried to get a doctor, but they said there was no one.
Some days later we went back to Dehli and having being to the doctor and having again bottled water, I was feeling healthy again.
